Could you diagnose how to check if ftp urls are connectable?

I done some diagnosis. url open with ftp will return a [urllib.response.addinfourl](https://docs.python.org/3/library/urllib.request.html#urllib.response.addinfourl) instance. There is a status method of addinfourl, but from python 3.9 only. And I have tried using python 3.10, the status only return None. 

It seems that if the ftp url can be open, then it is also connectable. So I added codes in can_connect to only check http/https url status.

comments: Thanks for the report. Investigation and PRs would certainly be welcome

`pd.read_fwf` tries to create a `FixedWidthFieldParser` using the given `urlopen` object. Since the `urlopen` object has a `readline` method, a `FixedWidthReader` object is constructed to read from this. 

Reading a line from the `FixedWidthReader` object using it's `__next__` method tries to call the `__next__` method of the `urlopen` object which does not exist throwing the above error.

---
Suggest replacing the iterator with a call to the `readline` method instead.
This works with 1.3.2, but there is currently no test for that.
